1-2: AGE COMPLEXITY (1-2 years / toddler): Extra-bold thick outer contours, huge simple closed shapes, and abundant open white space for chunky crayons. Include ONLY the main subject and at most 1-2 big, simple core theme elements in the background; omit all small secondary props, tiny patterns, and intricate background scenery.
3-4: AGE COMPLEXITY (3-4 years / preschool): Bold, smooth, clear outlines with large friendly coloring areas and uncluttered spacing. Include the main subject plus 2-3 clear core theme elements; keep clothing and backgrounds simple without small decorative patterns.
5-7: AGE COMPLEXITY (5-7 years / early school): Clean medium-bold outlines with well-defined coloring zones suitable for markers or colored pencils. Include the core theme elements plus 3-5 playful secondary storybook details in a balanced, readable composition while keeping faces clean and uncrowded.
8+: AGE COMPLEXITY (8+ years / older kids): Crisp medium outlines with richer layered storybook scenery, all secondary theme details, and tasteful decorative patterns on props and architecture, while still keeping pure white open regions (zero shading or hatching) and clean, natural faces.
